scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Original-dataset (arseniyshutko 129,880 rows) source-model prediction transferred CONDITIONALLY to competition fold-0 rows. Zero competition labels used for training or gating.

protocol.source_train: LGBM (xt_xt_f10-style, ES 250, seed 1) trained on ALL 129,880 original rows (21 covariates, original satisfaction labels only).
protocol.conditional_transfer: per-row blend weight w = 1 - normalized k-NN distance to the original training set (20-NN on standardized 21 covariates, w = clip(1 - d20/d95, 0, 1)); candidate = w*logit(p_source) + (1-w)*logit(p_route_ref). No label enters w.
protocol.evaluation: fold-0 AUC of candidate; port_delta = AUC(candidate) - AUC(route_ref on fold-0); corr = Spearman(candidate, route_ref).
protocol.control_context: plain equal-logit blend (w=0.5 everywhere) reported as the append-style contrast.

frozen_decision_rule: PROMISING iff port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995 (same frozen F2 bar as the FEAT screens).
non_goals: No competition label used anywhere in training or gating.
